source: Seams follow CodeHS AP CSA (Cortado) Unit 1 lessons 1.12-1.14 and Unit 3 lessons 3.3-3.9 (objects, anatomy of a class, constructors, methods, this). Structure only: no CodeHS text, problems or code is copied.

lessons.title: Writing a method
lessons.objective: Students will be able to write a method that takes no arguments, one that takes an argument and one that returns a value, and explain what this refers to inside a method.

lessons.title: Methods that work together
lessons.objective: Students will be able to call one method from another with this, move and remove a wrapped sprite from inside a method, and read a complete Enemy class that uses all of it.

lessons.title: Many instances
lessons.objective: Students will be able to build several instances of one class, keep them in an array, call a method on each one with a loop, and say what changes when a fourth enemy arrives in a procedural design and in an object design.

lessons.title: When to reach for OOP
lessons.objective: Students will be able to decide whether a class is the right tool with a three-question checklist, then write a Collectible class and build five of them.

lessons.title: Defend the choice
lessons.objective: Students will be able to compare a procedural and an object-oriented version of the same feature in writing, and say what changes when a fourth enemy arrives.

lessons.title: Name the pillars
lessons.objective: Students will be able to name encapsulation, inheritance and polymorphism, and extend their own class in a challenge.
